node.title: Global mixed-flux induction orients every max internal cell at fixed mu
node.statement: The accepted full-relay recurrences, sharp internal phase separation, positive max path matrix, and physical continuant bridge imply the strict fixed-mu q-orientation stated in CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-MAX-FIXED-MU-CELL-ORDER-R34.

node.title: Strict fixed-mu projective cell order for every max relay root
node.statement: For every finite R>1, integer n>=2, and every possibly asymmetric premise-complete transverse common-terminal max-law root with 2n relay events, let dot denote q partial_q at fixed mu. Every internal positive relay cell has dot(theta_i)<0, every internal negative relay cell has dot(theta_i)>0, and every internal projective flight alpha_i=atanh(sin(theta_i)sin(mu theta_i)/(1+cos(theta_i)cos(mu theta_i))) has dot(alpha_i)<0. Endpoint cells are excluded. No reflection hypothesis is used. The result does not sign the fixed-q mu field, the common-terminal feedback dq/dmu, the norm derivative, the full residual Jacobian, uniqueness, or general O3a.

node.title: Bridge fixed-mu max cell order to the norm-orientation scalar
node.statement: Combine the strict fixed-mu per-cell order with a rigorous fixed-q frequency response or an equivalent global feedback identity to orient the common-terminal norm derivative and full max residual Jacobian for every n, or produce an exact or certified physical counterexample.
node.formal_statement: For every finite R>1, integer n>=2, and every premise-complete transverse common-terminal max root, prove c'>0, equivalently the physical frequency Schur scalar S_eta<0, by adding sufficient control of the fixed-q mu field or of the common-terminal feedback to the R34 fixed-mu q-field order. Cover both midpoint parities, asymmetric roots, all relay chambers, and compatible limiting closures separately; alternatively certify a fully physical root with the opposite or zero orientation.
discharge_criteria: Control every finite R>1 and n>=2 max root, including both midpoint parities and arbitrary asymmetric premise-complete roots.
Retain the endpoint normalization and event saltation terms in the fixed-q mu field or an exactly equivalent border formulation.
Do not infer dq/dmu<0 from partial_q A_n>0 or from fixed-mu cell order without separately signing A_mu or the full two-residual Jacobian.
Treat R=1, grazing, collision, zero-amplitude, incomplete-word, and nontransverse closures explicitly rather than extending the strict chart by assertion.

A counterexample must satisfy the complete physical relay, common-terminal, equal-norm, event-count, and transversality predicates; coefficient-level or local-cell witnesses do not discharge the obligation.

node.statement: Use inverse positivity of the max physical path matrix and an endpoint-normalized mixed cross-Wronskian induction to prove strict fixed-mu phase and projective-flight order on every internal max cell. The fixed-q frequency response, norm orientation, full Jacobian, and all-n O3a remain open.

node.deliverable_contract: A universal finite-contrast fixed-mu internal-cell order theorem for the max branch and an exact identification of the remaining fixed-q frequency/norm bridge, without promoting local or numerical evidence to O3a.
falsification_tests: Reconstruct strict inverse positivity from L_+ positive definiteness, irreducibility, and the positive terminal continuant; entrywise nonnegativity alone is insufficient.
Check the first-event base N_1=-q^2+chi_1<-1 and every sign in the inherited mixed-flux recurrence; a purely local two-cell cone is known to fail.
Audit n=2, all n, both midpoint parities, asymmetric roots, endpoint exclusions, and the two degeneration classes separately.
Do not interpret fixed-mu q-order as fixed-q mu-order, common-terminal q feedback, a norm slope, a Jacobian theorem, or uniqueness.
Use exact symbolic replay only for identities; no finite scan or floating-point sign is a theorem premise.
node.expected_bottleneck: The fixed-q frequency response and endpoint-normalization border terms are not controlled by the fixed-mu positive path cone; an exact physical bridge to c'>0 or S_eta<0 is still required.

ordered_steps: For the logarithmic fixed-mu q-field, use the accepted saltation and cell-transfer recurrences and the terminal relative path equation L_+W=(w_m/a_m)e_last.

Use MAX-LOCAL-TWIST-R8 and PHYSICAL-CONTINUANT-R7 to obtain L_+ positive definite, irreducible with negative off-diagonals, and w_m>0. Strict inverse positivity then gives w_i>0 on every internal prefix.

For the time-translation comparison field define gamma_i, Y_i, chi_i, and H_i=Y_i+chi_i. Negative common energy gives H_i<0 and Y_i+chi_(i-1)<0; sharp R8 phase separation and strict increase of chi give sign(chi_(i-1)-chi_i)=sign(gamma_i).

Define the mixed flux N_i=gamma_i w_i-d_iH_i. The endpoint normalization gives N_1=-q^2+chi_1<-1, and exact saltation cancellation gives N_i(1+Delta_i/H_i)=N_(i-1)+gamma_iw_iDelta_i/H_i. The divisor is positive and the new source strictly negative, so N_i<0 globally by induction.

Differentiate each simple event and combine the q-field and time-translation recurrences to obtain dot(theta_i)=-sqrt(rho_i)K_iN_i/(gamma_i gamma_(i+1)). Successive event orientations and N_i<0 give sign dot(theta_i)=-sign K_i, hence positive cells contract and negative cells expand.

Differentiate the exact projective flight alpha_i. Its theta derivative has sign K_i on the two strict phase branches, so every internal dot(alpha_i) is strictly negative. Since q>1, the same signs hold for ordinary partial_q.
boundary_cases: For n=2 there are three internal cells; the endpoint base initializes the first and the same induction covers the remaining two without using the canonical n=2 norm theorem.
The proof uses neither reflection nor a midpoint condition and covers both midpoint parities and arbitrary asymmetric roots.
No phase or projective-flight conclusion is made for either endpoint cell; the left endpoint is used only through Y_0=-q^2, w_0=0, and d_1=-1.
R=1 and relay-chart degeneracies including grazing, collision, zero event amplitude, nontransversality, and incomplete words are outside the strict statement.
No uniform margin as R approaches 1 or infinity is asserted, and no fixed-q mu, common-terminal feedback, norm, Jacobian, or uniqueness conclusion is drawn.
